<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Bugbear Prowler](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2860)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Bugbear prowlers specialize in the art of lurking in the shadows.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 16

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14

<title level="2" right="Creature 2">[Bugbear Prowler](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2860)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Bugbear" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=744" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 47

**Perception** +7; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Goblin](/Languages.aspx?ID=6)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +6, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +7, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +4, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +2

**Con** +3

**Int** -1

**Wis** +1

**Cha** +0
</row>

**Items**
[Bastard Sword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=15), [Javelin](/Weapons.aspx?ID=71) (3), [Leather Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +9 

**Ref** +8 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 34

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
bastard sword +10 ([two-hand d12](/Traits.aspx?ID=198)),
**Damage** 1d8+4 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fist +10 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188)),
**Damage** 1d4+4 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
javelin +8 ([thrown 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)),
**Damage** 1d6+4 piercing

**Bushwhack  The bugbear prowler Strides up to 10 feet and attempts to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376) a creature they're [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) by. If they succeed, they also deal fist damage to that creature.** <actions string="Single Action" />  

**Mauler**   The bugbear prowler gains a +3 circumstance bonus to damage rolls against creatures they have [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77).

</column>
